name: Vespid Dynamics Needlestorm NS-4 'Pincushion'
description: A compact flechette pistol that fires salvos of micro-darts from a rotating drum magazine. Each dart carries a piezoelectric charge that discharges on penetration, causing involuntary muscle contraction around the wound channel. Vespid markets it as a 'compliance sidearm' but field reports document fatalities from cardiac disruption when dart clusters strike the thorax.
specifications:
caliber: 1.2mm tungsten-carbide flechette
magazine: 120-dart rotary drum
rate of fire: 15-dart burst per trigger pull
effective range: 8-30 meters
weight: 0.9 kg loaded
power source: Integrated piezo-charge, no external battery
story_hooks: A batch of NS-4 darts has surfaced with a neurotoxin coating not listed in any Vespid catalog — someone is weaponizing the platform beyond spec.
A clinic in the lower tiers is overwhelmed with patients showing identical flechette wound patterns — someone is using Pincushions for systematic intimidation.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, angular sidearm with an aggressive forward rake. The rotating drum magazine dominates the grip area, creating a bulbous profile that tapers toward a short, precisely machined muzzle. Resembles a scaled-down rotary cannon crossed with a dental tool — purposeful, clinical, predatory.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length 16 cm, height 10 cm, width 4.5 cm. Muzzle length 3.2 cm with visible acceleration ports
physical_description.weight_description: Dense and balanced despite compact size — 0.9 kg feels substantial in the palm, suggesting concentrated engineering rather than bulk. Sits low and forward in hand due to magazine distribution
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy frame with tungsten-carbide acceleration sleeve. Rotating drum is hardened steel with visible chamber ports
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed titanium accents around trigger guard and safety lever. Micro-abraded grip section for secure purchase. Faint tool marks visible on drum housing, suggesting precision manufacturing
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with silver-gray barrel sleeve and black polymer trigger guard. Faint blue LED indicator near drum axis (piezo-charge status)
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with embedded cooling grooves — deliberately abraded to prevent slipping. Feels slightly warm to touch due to integrated charge dissipation
distinctive_features: Exposed rotating drum with 120 visible micro-dart chambers arranged in tight helical pattern
Muzzle cluster of 4 precision acceleration ports arranged in diamond pattern
Piezo-indicator LED (blue when charged, amber when depleted) embedded near mag release
Safety lever with VESPID embossed lettering — aggressive serif font
Micro-serrated edges along top rail for accessory mounting
Faint burnish marks on drum where rounds have cycled — sign of heavy use
Vented heat dissipation slots along barrel assembly
Trigger with trigger guard safety — deep, defensive geometry
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS logo stamped on left grip plate (hexagon with stylized wasp silhouette). Serial number engraved on drum axis. 'NS-4 PINCUSHION' designation stenciled in small capitals on barrel sleeve. Small compliance certification plate under grip
physical_description.condition_typical: Field units show burnished chamber ports from sustained fire, light scoring on drum from rapid cycling, and micro-pitting on muzzle crown. Grip texture worn smooth in high-contact areas. Piezo-indicator may show inconsistent illumination after extended deployment
